values.en: In arithmetic, $t:I$ is coerced to a real number. An argument such as $1-t$, $2t$ or $2t-1$ denotes the corresponding interval subtype element, with the membership proof suppressed: $1-t\in I$ for every $t\in I$; $2t\in I$ on $0\le t\le 1/2$; $2t-1\in I$ on $1/2\le t\le1$. The two pieces agree at $t=1/2$, so either branch can include the seam. The defining lambda has product domain $I\times X$, not a curried domain.
values.zh-CN: 算术中的 $t:I$ 按实数强制转换。$1-t$、$2t$、$2t-1$ 作区间实参时表示对应的子类型元素，省略其隶属证明：任意 $t\in I$ 有 $1-t\in I$；$0\le t\le1/2$ 时 $2t\in I$；$1/2\le t\le1$ 时 $2t-1\in I$。两段在 $t=1/2$ 相等，因此中点可归入任一分支。定义中的 lambda 的定义域是 $I\times X$，不是柯里化的定义域。
